items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: And then I met A. K. Atkinson, he was working in a road house in that town, along with Clark Terry.

ctx.x: How did that particular thing come about?
Well, I knew about it and so I came up here on a holiday. So he said, you know, it's a thing that everybody does, you know, Billy Taylor Jr., and Clark Terry and all

the guys do. Milt Hinton and all the guys do it. It's just one of those things, you know, and it's these business men that played music, that played jazz to help their way through college or whatever or they played it in their youth. And on Friday afternoon, instead of going back to work, they come up to Jazz at Noon and they play and they have a guest, you know, every Sunday. Of course Les plays alto himself, you know, and he plays too and it's a nice atmosphere, you know.
